metadata.description: Handcrafted plugins for serious AI-assisted development — autonomous agents, context compression, and tools that get out of your way.

plugins.name: epic
plugins.description: 3 commands + 19 auto-trigger skills + self-evolving agent harness. Autonomous /orbit pipeline, TDD enforcement, and hooks that guard every session.

plugins.name: llm-transpile
plugins.description: Token-optimized document reader — silently compresses .md, .html, and .txt files on Read, cutting context usage by up to 40% with zero workflow change.

plugins.name: alcove
plugins.description: Local-first MCP memory server — hybrid BM25+vector search, vault management, and launchd lifecycle for persistent project knowledge.

plugins.name: velith
plugins.description: AI-native publishing system — autonomous multi-phase workflows from ideation to EPUB/PDF. Build books like software.

plugins.name: obscura-plugin
plugins.description: Headless browser as MCP tools — fetch, scrape, extract markdown, and run JS evals. Zero config, auto-installs binaries on first load.

plugins.name: episteme
plugins.description: Software engineering knowledge graph — design patterns, laws, code smells, and refactorings with graph traversal and AI-powered code analysis.

plugins.name: obsidian-forge
plugins.description: Obsidian vault lifecycle management — AI inbox classification, graph strengthening, MOC regeneration, and multi-vault sync as agent skills.

plugins.name: epicsagas
plugins.description: Personal agent skill collection — problem discovery (5 Whys, JTBD, Fishbone), introspect (bias detection, thinking pattern analysis), and OSS distribution readiness.

plugins.name: byoh
plugins.description: BuildYourOwnHarness — build, deploy, and evolve a personalized AI agent harness from an interview. Synthesis recombines vetted skills/agents under 3 safety gates.
